name: adlc
description: Agentic Development Lifecycle pack: six phases from business intent to production (discover, design, build, evaluate, release, observe), each ending in a named-role approval gate, with templates, contracts, policy hooks and subagents.
examples: Turn this business goal into a requirements spec
Draft the Level-1 plan and architecture decisions
Build the approved units in bolts, with tests
Evaluate the build against the spec's thresholds
